summary: Analysis and design-only phase (no implementation, no gate code changed, no change to accepted fast_green value shapes). Responds to the governance gap Phase 149O.20L.7O.2P surfaced: _fast_green_failure_signal()/validate_derived_correctness() (phase_reports.py) validate a single free-text/mapping fast_green scalar and block on any nonzero failure count with no structured escape hatch -- a deliberate and correct 134E.9.1 fix against narration-based false-clean claims, but one that conflates 'repository has zero known failures' with 'this phase introduced zero regressions' into one field, forcing the only available workaround (a manually --deselect-ed clean count) to hide the real raw count and its rationale outside the gate's reach. Section 1 documents this insufficiency with the concrete 149O.20L.7O.2P case (0 fixed, 0 attributable regressions, 2 non-regression differences: an expected phase artifact and a confirmed environment flake, both currently only expressible via the deselection workaround). Section 2 states the design goal: certify 'this change introduced zero attributable regressions' rather than 'the entire repository has zero historical failures,' without loosening the existing no-narration-override invariant. Section 3 defines a five-bucket evidence model (raw_failures, attributable_failures, excluded_preexisting_failures, excluded_environment_failures, expected_phase_artifacts) with the invariant that raw_failures is always the disjoint union of the other four -- an unclassified failure is itself a gate failure. Section 4 defines per-bucket classification methods requiring attached, checkable evidence (baseline node-ID set difference, isolated rerun result, named test-to-cause mapping), not narration. Section 5 gives a backward-compatible schema extension to test_results['fast_green'] (legacy scalar/mapping form entirely unchanged and permanently supported). Section 6 defines completion criteria for a future implementation phase: attributable_failures must be empty, every raw_failures member must be classified, every exclusion entry must carry required evidence, with the same fail-closed, no-narration-override property preserved exactly. Section 7 keeps push-eligibility (governance_results.pcae_push_check, pushed_status) structurally independent from test attribution, so a phase cannot use one gate to launder the other. Section 8 lists explicit non-goals (no gate code touched, no retroactive reclassification of 149O.20L.7O.2P). Section 9 recommends the next phase as a contained implementation-only follow-on. Full document: docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2Q_ATTRIBUTION_AWARE_VERIFICATION_GATE_ARCHITECTURE.md.
